text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a spectacle so breathtakingly 
vivid, it made me forget to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Fuji Kiseki crossed the finish line in 
1st place, the grandstands erupted into an 
earth-shaking roar of cheers.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh! This is the best! The 
absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Congraduladions! Congradulations, 
congradulations, Lady Fuji~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the miracle 
(kiseki)! *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Thousands of spectators held their 
breath, waiting for her single word."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With every single breath, with every 
single move she made, thousands of 
spectators were captivated by the dream.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I want you, and only you, to burn my 
image into your memory. With those 
pitch-black eyes of yours...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAAHH--!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's... that scenery...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Stay calm. A true entertainer sees it 
through to the end...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki closed her eyes and offered an 
elegant bow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—To receive such a loving standing 
ovation, I am beyond honored.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And with this, the miracle of this year's 
Senior Class draws to a close. The time 
has come for the performer to return 
backstage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, fret not! My story does not end 
here!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Fuji Kiseki spread her arms wide―― 
fireworks filled the sky.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And beyond that, the continuation of 
today's miracle! I swear I will deliver it 
to you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Well then, goodbye and farewell!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the radiant sky behind her, everyone 
gazed at the smiling Fuji Kiseki with 
longing in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That marks the end of Chapter 1, I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. I'm certain of it, but 
there's something I want to ask you 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
... I wonder if I managed to become the 
ultimate entertainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The roar of the stands was just like the 
fervor of her mother's stage performance 
she'd watched with Fuji Kiseki back 
then—no, it was even greater.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. What a relief. If you say so, 
it must be true."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
―― This is a confession you can just 
ignore, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, somewhere in my heart, 
I've never been able to forgive my younger 
self.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Having failed to realize my yearning upon 
the stage, I simply had to."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why, no matter how many victories 
I racked up, I could never find true 
confidence."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even as I walked down the path of racing, 
my young self was still right there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, I felt like I might 
finally be able to forgive them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki gave a bashful smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is my path... No, this is where I 
belong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The red glow of the evening sun slowly 
illuminated Fuji Kiseki's profile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could say anything, she turned on 
her heel and walked away.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, I can't stay lost in 
sentimentality forever!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
An ending is just a new beginning. On to 
the next show, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If it's us, I'm sure we can go anywhere.
